name: Stitch
tagline: A web video editor where you edit the timeline by hand or by describing changes to an AI agent.
problem: Timeline editors intimidate beginners and interrupt experienced creators.
solution: A full-stack editor with a familiar timeline plus an agent that trims, rearranges, adds audio and generates transitions directly on the timeline while respecting its structure.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for an edit in plain words and watch the timeline change.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Gemini API” among 160 submissions.
The agent edits the real timeline rather than suggesting changes.

lessons: An agent that acts inside a familiar tool is easier to trust than a separate chat.
